2026-10-05.note: First time taking photos with a 'real' camera. Had tons of fun. Saw a beautiful Great Egret hunting for dinner, a couple of ducks being silly, a hawk overlooking the bayou, and a mama alligator sunbathing with her babies.

species.wood-duck: The male Wood Duck is so pretty with its colorful patterns. The female here is a gray-brown with a white eye-ring.

2026-10-06.note: Lovely Tuesday. Spent a lot of time playing around with the camera and looking for small things to capture. I saw a women with her husband and she had a very large and fancy camera. I introduced myself and asked her some questions. She was very friendly. I think I made a friend.
